balls.text: its all happening! goes for an almighty hoick, mis-hits it and it goes really high, probably out of Srivastava's sight before coming back down, and he fails to gather the catch at midwicket. But he fires in a good throw to hit the stumps down at the striker's end. The batsman's just made his ground though. Sreesanth is quite disappointed with the drop.
fulltoss outside off, sliced over the in field by RP, it almost runs down to the cover boundary, but is saved well by Bopara. Barath tidies up.
whacks the length ball down to long off for one

almost another run out. Great yorker from Sree, RP Singh just about squeezes it out and takes off. Sree runs forward, picks up and tries to throw the stumps down at the non-striker's end, but RP was in the way.

great work from Sanga! The attempted guide to third man goes to his right. Sanga gathers, does not bother with trifles like removing the gloves and calmly under-arms a throw to hit down the stumps at the striker's end.
fullish on offstump and moved down straight to long off, on the bounce, for a single
wide outside off, tapped away to point. Good over from Irfan.

and he's got a wicket! Punjab have come back really well in the end overs. This time, it is short of a length and wide of off stump. Vaas looks to hoist it over long off, but that is quite far from him and he gets no timing. Bipul runs in to take another nice catch.
just eludes Bopara's fingers at midwicket. Goes down as a drop.
Full ball on middle, drilled off the front foot towards mid on, nice stop at midwicket saves a run.
very wide of Vaas, and he stretches big time to get bat on it, runs away to cover for a single
gets the yorker in this time, albeit slightly wide outside off. Vaas crunches it to point and they run a tight single. Direct hit could have had Suman in trouble.
short this time, and Vaas was waiting for it. Expertly pulled over the infield towards midwicket for four more.
beautiful shot from Vaas! Full and slow, he picked the line and length and dismissed it down the ground with a straight bat.
very short bouncer, was probably close to being called a wide. Vaas lets it go.
slower ball on a length on leg stump, Suman waits and chips it to midwicket and they run a quick single. 128 kph that.
short and outside off, Vaas pulls it down the ground for one
drives down to long on to retain strike.
fulltoss on offstump and driven away to the sweeper at cover

top catch from Bipul at long on! Symonds looks to hoist Yuvi over the ropes, but can't get enough elevation. Bipul runs in, dives forward and picks it an inch above the turf. The umpires took a few looks at it, but that's out.
full this time on offstump and Suman plays that extra cover loft again. There's a fielder this time
this time, Suman gets hold of him! Picks the short ball well and deposits it over midwicket. Good hit!
full and inch-perfect line from Yuvi once again. Symonds can't get any elevation and drives down.
tries a repeat of his four earlier in the over, but this time Suman can't connect with his intended lofted extra-cover drive
full on leg again, Symonds comes forward and wrists it away to mid wicket
legspinner on a length outside off and smartly played. Lofts it just over the infield and it runs away to the cover boundary.
full on leg, driven to long on for a single
short on leg stump, Symonds stays back and plays it to midwicket to bring up a fine fifty.
falls short of Chawla at long off. Symonds looked for the expansive loft over long off, but did not time it, Chawla had to run in and put in a dive, but he was late on the move.
Symmo jumps out, but can't reach the pitch and quietly taps it away.
this time he does. Down to long on to turn the strike.
length ball and a very good line. Cramps Suman for room and he can't get it away.
fuller, driven back to Yuvraj who tumbles awkwardly.
nicely played! Short ball outside off, and he had to make all the running there. Hit it off the back foot over extra cover for a crucial four.
comes around the wicket and directs the short ball in from wide outside off, but Suman guides it easily down to third man for one
full on off stump, drives off the front foot straight to Bopara at cover.
mis-hits the pull to a well-directed bouncer, it goes high stays there for a while and lands in no-man's land at midwicket
length ball outside off, Symonds stays back and crunches it behind point for one
short this time, and Symonds looks for an expansive cut, but does not connect. Two dots in two.
short of a length on off stump, tapped away towards point off the backfoot and lets out a loud cry of "No"
very tight lines for Yuvraj. Pushes him back and he can't get it past the bowler.
down the track, misses and Sanga misses the stumping. First blemish in the fielding.
eased down to long off for a single. Symmo is crucial
short of a length, and hit back very hard to Yuvraj who does not flinch as he takes it on the bounce.
gets forward and guides it down to mid wicket for a run. Symmo to face
drifts to leg this time, and he works it away to get off the mark.
on a length outside offstump, played aaway carefully off the backfoot

another one bites the dust! Anirudh is gone for a duck. Straight length ball, he tried to work it down to the offside and got a faint edge, which Sangakkara held well. Punjab are pegging Deccan back with these quick strikes.
shorter this time, wary of letting Symonds come forward. He stays back and taps it towards square leg
Symonds does it again! This is golf at its very best. Bangs the ball on offstump easily, very very high and it clears long off easily.

superb piece of fielding by Mahela Jayawardene from point! Rohit steers it down to point and takes off for a tight single. The throw was fired in to the non-striker's end and Rohit had to put in the dive, but it was all over. Third umpire completes the formalities and Deccan have lost two here.
similar ball, Symonds taps it down to mid off to rotate the strike
on a length on offstump, driven down to long off to get off the mark
and he's got him! Short ball, but ramrod straight, Gibbs looks to mow it down to cow corner, but can't make connection. Stumps are down. Yuvraj's picked a huge wicket.
oh, he's lost it, probably slipped out. Waist high fulltoss again drifting down the leg, Symonds is caught by surprise but gets some bat on it to fine leg for four more.
tries another slower ball, and it slips down the legside, Symonds gets something on it and sends it on its way to fine leg. Gift
slower ball, picked early and whacked! 123.7 kph, full on offstump, and Symonds was waiting. Sends it high over long on this time. Top shot
short of a length outside off and Gibbs pulls it down towards midwicket for a single.
slightly wider of offstump this time and he gets it down to third man off the backfoot
on a length on offstump and Symonds can't get it past point, off the backfoot
gets it away this time, length ball outside off and guided to the left of point for a single.
very full and Symmo can't get it past point. No run
drives it down to mid off. Irfan's not swinging it anymore.
whack! Dragged the length ball on middle stump towards midwicket without any fuss. Nice shot.
full and wide of offstump, drives very hard by Gibbs but straight to cover
slower ball from Irfan. played away to midwicket
finishes off with a single towards mid wicket
Symmo tees off! Overpitched on offstump, he got forward and went dead straight and well over the ropes.
draws him forward, Gibbs drives it down to mid off
full toss, Gibbs drives it through the covers, would have wanted to do more with that gift.
straighter ball this time, Symonds comes forward and drives towards mid on
full ball, driven down to mid off for one
angles in this time towards leg, and Gibbs clips it away off the backfoot for a single to square leg
driven nicely down to mid off for another single
that's well run. Gets forward and taps it towards cover and Symonds responds.
tapped away by Symonds behind square for a single
beauty shot! This man has a wonderful cover-drive. Comes forward, gets to the pitch and lofts it over cover for a really pretty boundary
gets it away through mid on for another single
safely tapped away for a single through midwicket
very full this time, and Symonds can't get it past mid on
on leg stump this time, tucks it away for a single off the front foot
pitched up, draws the batsman forward, drives to cover
ah, another inside edge, this time from Symonds, misses the stumps and flies to fine leg for four
almost has Gibbs caught and bowled. It pops up off his bat towards the bowler, and just eludes the outstretched hands
more swing, back into Symonds and catches him by surprise. A hint of inside edge off the back foot, on to the pads and it dribbles between keeper and slip
shorter this time, and an almighty swing from Symonds from outside off towards midwicket. Makes no contact.
ball's not coming on to the bat. Gibbs gets forward and looks to drive, it pops up but safely to mid off
nice swing, beats the attempted hoick and just misses the stumps.
short of a length outside off. Symonds stays back and guides it to point.
again draws Gibbs forward, and he drives it softly very straight. Irfan puts in the dive and keeps it down to one.
pitched up on offstump and defended off the front foot

oh, that's a wayward throw and its smashed into Laxman's fore-arm at the non-strikers' end. Pitched up by Sree and Laxman part wrists, part drives it to mid on and they take off for a tight single. Srivastava's throw was way off the mark - he probably thought Laxman was batting in Hyderabad, instead of Cuttack. Laxman was caught unawares and that's a painful blow. He grimaces and gets rid of the gloves.
again, a McGrathesque line and length from Sreesanth, he needs to maintain it though. Played away off the front foot to short midwicket and Gibbs opens his account
pitched up by Sreesanth and it moved away a touch. Gibbs came forward and drove to mid off

against the run of play! Short again from the left-armer, Gilchrist was into the pull, probably a little early and it took the top edge and ballooned to short midwicket, where Mahela Jayawardene took a nice running catch. Big wicket - Gilchrist looked menacing in those 17 minutes.
just short of the rope! Problems aplenty for Sanga, as Gilchrist is laying into them, irrespective of the length. This was further up and he swung it from outside off to midwicket for four.
short again, at 130 kph and Gilchrist did not time the pull very well, but it just kept running away from mid on. Four more for Gilly - he's off to a flier
pulls the short one comfortably. Not much pace on offer, so the bouncer is not threatening.
and this time, he Laxmans it to midwicket, wrists all over that, a hint of inswing, but he picked it and tucked it away.
welcome Shalabh! On a length, angling across, Laxman opens the face deftly and runs it down to third man, this outfield is lightning quick.
creamed through the covers! Short of a length, angling from middle towards the slips, Gilly picks it early and punishes it in typical fashion through the offside cordon. Big over!

and he makes him pay for the indiscretion! Sree tries to bounce Gilchrist, but at 134 kph, for a man bred at the WACA, that sat up and asked to be hit. Gilly was in position and pulled it high over square leg. Six more!
pressure's on Sreesanth and it shows. Attempted slower ball goes awry, down the leg side
see you later! Similar ball, good length outside off and angling away. Gilchrist picks it early and hammers it straight for a six.
shot! That one did not come on to the bat, and the length was not there either, but these things matter very little to Gilly who swings it from outside off to midwicket.
china cut eludes offstump, not by much. Angles across Gilchrist, cramping him for room, and the cut runs down to fine leg.
short of a length, swinging away. Laxman reaches out and taps it to third man. Definite swing on offer here.
and again. Irfan's got that famous banana-swing that was the toast of 2003-04 going. Gilly drives off the front foot to mid off
nice swing again, and Gilchrist plays it in the air, off the outside half, over cover. Nice fielding at the cover boundary
misses the slog to midwicket. Nice shape away again and not the right shot for that ball.
fuller this time, on offstump, and shapes back in. Irfan half-stops Laxman's check drive but can't stop the single.
short of a length on middle, very slight movement into Laxman. Taps it away to the legside
tight run. Nice swinging delivery from Irfan, Gilchirst stays back and carefully guides it to cover and runs. A direct hit would have been interesting.
length again, Sree comes halfway down the track again, and carves it over cover yet again, but can only get four of the 11 Punjab need to get on the victory board.
fulltoss again, Sree is out once again and this time swings it away to extra cover for four.
and misses again, length ball, Sree can't make contact. Through to Gilchrist.
lands it this time. Sreesanth charges out again, but its a length ball and he cannot connect. Dot ball.
Sree jumps out and is susprised by a high fulltoss. Goes for an almighty swing, which somehow connects and inexplicably runs to the third man fence.

and Irfan goes, what a tragedy! Length ball again on off stump, and Irfan looks for the fence over cow corner, but he has the small matter of getting past that man, Andrew Symonds. Ain't happening today, Symmo takes the catch easily and Irfan has to go. Huge wicket and belatedly, one believes the last nail on the coffin.
and he gets the yorker in finally. Irfan squeezes it away to deep point and crucially retains strike for the last over.
it falls in no man's land! Short ball, goes for the pull and top edges it, but there's no one at deep square to take it.
Irfan, I'm your fan! Another big hit, he's turning it on here. Goes over long on this time, the length ball is not working. RP needs to find the yorker.
expertly threaded through the covers! Full on offstump, Irfan went over cover and found the gap. Superb fifty this.
drilled down to long off, only for a single. Pressure's on Irfan.
good ball from RP. On the length, and Bipul can't get it past RP.
full on Bipul's legs and he can't do much with it. Just a single down to midwicket.
gets it away square to the leg side for one.
Symmo shows how it is done! Well swept again by Irfan to square leg and Symmo puts in a big dive, running in from midwicket, to stop it from going for four.
wide down the leg and it's taken some pad and run away to the boundary. Hiccups in the Deccan camp!
well hit and very badly fielded at deep midwicket. Down on one knee and hit hard, and it went through the fielder's legs.

mis-hit this time, its outside offstump and Irfan top-edges the slog this time. It flies to the vacant third man region and goes into the bounday boards after one bounce. Finally some spunk from Punjab
again! Irfan's batted superbly today, and there's no let up, he's sent it in the same direction, flatter and over the ropes

that's flown out of Cuttack, and possibly landed in Bhubaneshwar! Launched out of the ground, over midwicket by Irfan. Picked the length ball early and swung his arms well, and it went right off the meat!
swatted away from off stump towards square leg by Irfan. Four runs.
full loosener at RP and it is very nearly hit straight back at him by Bisla. Clears RP and goes for a single
well, Punjab surely did not need the time out, since Piyush goes first ball after the break. Looks to pull fine, but it goes straight to the short fine-leg fielder.
outside off this time, driven down for one.
straight on middle stump and he can't work it away through the legside.
on leg stump this time, and worked away towards fine leg
short ball, punches it off the backfoot towards long off
shorter and angling across Irfan, who works it away towards midwicket
worked away from legstump towards square leg
does not time it this time, and mistimes it so badly that it falls well short of mid off.
majestic from Irfan! Full from Vaas on his legstump and he lofts it in style, between long on and mid wicket for six. Nice swing of the bat.
fuller, gets forward and drives down to long off
punched off the backfoot, just over the outstretched hand of a jumping short cover and it runs away for four.
shortens the length, on off stump, Chawla can't get it past the bowler
length ball on middle stump, gets forward and drives to long on
Vaas back in, and slides one down the leg. Neat take from Gilly, standing up to the stumps.
Chawla jumps out this time, but he's not as tall as Irfan and does not get to the pitch. Taps it away to the offside.
nearly does him this time. Inside edged past the stumps
wide down the leg and it runs off Gilly's pads
beautifully struck! Shades of Ganguly there as Irfan jumps out, gets to the pitch and goes through with a bombastic loft over long on. Huge.
looks to sweep from the legstump line, goes off the pads very fine and all the way for four
looks to flick from the leg-stump but can't get past short midwicket
guides it from close to the stumps towards point region off the backfoot
on Pathan's pads, cramping him for room. The ball tricked towards point and they run one.
fuller and driven down to long off
nice off-cutter, just eludes Piyush Chawla's outside edge

things are going all pear-shaped for Punjab here in Cuttack! Bopara goes now, looking to find the midwicket boundary, but the flat hit finds Symonds, who somehow catches the ball between his left forearm and chest.
outside leg and turning in again, turned away off the backfoot towards midwicket
picked away nicely from middle and leg towards midwicket
same line, but fuller and Irfan sweeps it behind square
pitches outside leg and turns towards Pathan's leg stump
full on the offstump and whipped away towards midwicket for a single
full toss on offstump from over the wicket, driven down safely for a single
full again and driven down to long on by Irfan to get off zero.
full on Irfan's pads, he gets forward and drives to mid on
swept away from the leg stump line towards square leg
timed neatly off the backfoot. Short and wide outside off, he stays back and sends it away to the cover boundary.

caught in the deep! Pitched up by Ojha and Barath looks to go over long off, but sadly he's no Symonds, he's actually around half his size. It loops up to long off and is taken comfortably inside the ropes.
works it away well from outside off towards the legside for a run.
Barath's had enough. Puts his knee down and mows the length ball to mid wicket.
nicely bowled and superbly fielded again by Rohit, dives to his right to cut off the straight drive
fulltoss outside off, hits it down the ground, should have gone for more.
hit towards the offisde, nicely saved by the bowler diving to his left
stays back and pats it towards point, can't get it past
short of a length, stays back and pats back to the bowler
gets forward and drives nicely to mid off
fuller on offstump, and turning away, takes a thick outside edge towards point
powerfully swept, but straight to midwicket
a touch of inswing there, Bopara gets a thick inside edge towards midwicket
Barath off the mark, nudged the length ball on leg stump, towards square leg
takes the cheekiness a step too far! Tries to sweep a straight and fast ball, misses and the stumps are down. No need to play that shot given the situation. Punjab are in big trouble.
Mahela unfurls another delicate, very late, late cut to the left of short third man. It races away for four. Super shot!
short outside off, he stays back and cuts it towards cover
paddle scoops it from well outside off, down to fine leg for a couple
short and wider this time and Mahela is unable to capitalise. Misses the cut.
and again! Mahela square cuts it this time to the right of point and it runs along the carpet for four more.

very full on middle and leg, paddled away nicely by Bopara. They run hard for three as Jaskaran effects a good save and sends in a strong throw, but its not a direct hit. It could have been interesting if he hit the stumps.
fuller to Bopara, brings him forward and makes him drive back
straighter this time and turned away to square leg
Mahela welcomes Ojha with a lovely late cut for four. Short on offstump, he rocks back and sends it to the left of point. Top stroke
tidies up nicely off his own bowling, running to the leg side to deny a single
pretty shot from Bopara. Just short of a length, but he extended his arms and sent it over mid off, couple of bounces over the ropes
shorter and wide outside off, Bopara cannot capitalise.
drifts on to middle and leg and he works it away nicely to midwicket to get off the mark
pats the length ball back towards the bowler
he's bowling medium pace. On a length on off stump and blocked away by Mahela

oh Yuvi, Yuvi, what have you done here!  It's outside off this time, short of a length and he looks to play a nothing shot without getting anywhere near the pitch of the ball. It balloons up towards cover point for a simple catch. Big blow!
that's a Yuvraj specialty! It's on his pads, full, he picks the line and length early and sends it flying over midwicket with a flick of the wrists
Nice and tight line again, on Yuvraj's off stump, he defends it down to mid on
On a length outside off, defended by Yuvraj towards point
full on Yuvraj's pads and he can't take advantage. Goes straight to short midwicket for none.
on a length on off stump and it stops a bit on Yuvraj, who plays it away off the backfoot towards mid on
hoick! Shades of Afridi there, only with a lot more grace. Full on leg stump, Bopara picks it up and deposits it towards midwicket. That raced away off the bat.
and he loses the radar this time. Strays down the leg for a wide.
good lines, Bopara is trying to break free, but can't connect off the backfoot
short of a length on offstump, Bopara stays back and taps it to Symmo who swoops in and cuts it off easily
full on offstump, nice punched off the front foot for a quick single. The attempted shy misses the stumps and they run an overthrow.
short and angling away from Bopara, who looks to play the backfoot square drive but can't pass point

Vaas gives his Sri Lankan mate with a beautiful off cutter! Beat's Sanga's forward prod and sneaks in between bat and pad to disturb timber. Vaas has struck a purple patch in the IPL and it's only fair, he now has the Purple Cap, with six wickets!
full on offstump and Sanga punches it nicely off the front foot, but can't find the gap. Gilly is standing up now.
full on Sanga's legs, he gets forward and drives it to mid-on.

Bisla is run out! It's amazing how often close lbw appeals force batsmen to run like headless chickens! Nice offcutter from Vaas, rapped him on the pads and he let out a huge appeal. The ball dribbled to point where Suman swooped and threw down the stumps to catch Bisla well short. He had gone halfway down and turned back. Good throw, though there was time to relay it.
subtle change of pace by Vaas. Bopara comes forward and defends
and a very good bouncer to sign off. Bisla is again pushed back and forced to duck, that was headed for his head. Some swing here for RP Swingh!
and he's through him there. Hint of inswing from offstump, its short of a length and Bisla was all over it. Goes just over the stumps.
on off stump, nice line and length.
straight on off, played carefully off the backfoot down the ground
miss by Gibbs gives away an overthrow. Good ball from RP, hint of swing back in to Bopara, who plays it to Gibbs and takes a few paces. The under-armed throw misses and they run one
short of a length outside off, looks to cut but does not connect
nice bouncer, he looks to press forward but is quickly pushed back and he ducks.
on offstump this time, he looks to get forward and defends.
full on legstump, judders into his pads and there is a stifled appeal, but it was sliding down
similar ball, similar shot, different execution, similar result! Inside edges the drive to the left of Gilchrist and it races away for four.
caresses it away through the covers! Vaas pitches it up and looks for swing, but finds one and Bopara gets all text-bookish with it.
